title: Research: certify PR2942 single-shear retiming boundary (no new kappa)
body:
PR2942 leaves gate retiming as an open way to reduce its normal45 overhead. This package proves a scoped boundary: moving any one of its four terminal A additions backward as a single-accumulator scalar row cannot lower the paid frame cost. **Negative result / exact finite research note; no new κ.**

- Both pinned providers, **16,072 cut positions**, arbitrary replacement-source order and all non-prelude A frames: 1,860 cuts are rejected by explicit vector witnesses; the remaining cuts reduce to **24 exact frame optima**, all with the original profile `{1:2434,2:632,3:286,4:104,5:26,8:8}`. Variable elimination uses certified rational comparisons uniformly around the reported complex endpoint, with no floating-point solver verdict.
- A bounded full-rank-one transport extension rejects **14,156 earlier cut/operator cases** by directed information-path witnesses, including alternative scalar factorizations with auxiliary registers. Eight cases (four cuts per provider) remain explicitly unresolved by that necessary test. No universal retiming impossibility is claimed.
- Every baseline and optimized representative passes full forward/dual free-operator replay on 632 independent inputs and 86 private zero buffers; cleanup is regenerated. An independent explicit-subset implementation checks the complete chronological frame invoice. **25 negative rejections and nine positive control groups** are retained.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/normal45-a-retiming-boundary
```

Expected: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result`. Registered CPython 3.12.14 passes. A Git-free, read-only export under CPython 3.14.7 with `-I -B -O` reproduces the same deterministic result (78.13 s; peak RSS 396 MiB). Metadata/source pins, syntax and committed-byte preflight pass. Hosted CI is separate; native Clifford realization, owner admission, precision/tape, outer release and all-size/compiler hypotheses are not re-proved.

Scientific base `95ff4e2dd396c505932a43ff7c1cdfdd94b8c867`; source PR2942 `a027b0f6fdb0ab2b42ba10fc31b53960166bf2bf`. Main refreshed to `389fa10d714f5b40afe624908e487eb5e424498d`; selected record and priority revision unchanged; new archive-intake guidance read. Full open-PR/discussion overlap refresh completed at 14:06 UTC. PR2948 (`34e1080739e5e8a4349f8582c31dca798c308d4a`) changes nine other operations on PR2917/PR2930 and advertises a higher conditional κ; this result does not constrain that changed word or compete for the headline. Archival merging of predecessor packages is not treated as mathematical endorsement.

Only `research/normal45-a-retiming-boundary/` is added (about 280 KB, including two necessary compressed words and three unchanged retained modules). No selected/frontier, upstream, shared code or frozen evidence edits.
